groups.label: Character / Portrait
best_for: text-only character scene portraits on flux-2-pro
Flux 2 Dev LoRA portraits only when the LoRA base model is FLUX.2-dev
prompt_rules: The served flux-2-pro route (fal-ai/flux-2-max) takes a text prompt only; no reference images are sent.
FLUX.1-dev aesthetic or character LoRAs are not compatible with Flux 2 routes.
Trained LoRAs must pass license plus FLUX.2-dev base-model gates before generation.
Operator supplies scenario; flux-2-pro locks no identity, so Character Lock refuses characters with reference images or a LoRA on it.

workflows.label: Character Scene
workflows.description: Place a character into a scenario. The served FLUX.2 Pro route takes text only, so no identity references are sent; trained LoRAs require a compatible Flux 2 Dev base.

groups.label: NB2
prompt_rules: Use @imageN inline when references matter.
Prefer preservation clauses over loose negative prompts.
Resolution is 1K, 2K, or 4K; 2K is default for most app workflows.
Maximum 14 references.

workflows.label: KDP Color Thumbnail
workflows.description: Color a KDP line-art thumbnail with crayon, marker, or colored pencil.

workflows.label: Multi-Reference Composition
workflows.description: Combine product, person, environment, and layout references with explicit @imageN roles.

groups.label: Qwen Image
prompt_rules: Keep prompt under the qwen-image contract cap.
Use size format like 1024*1024, not 1024x1024.
No separate negative_prompt field on the current WaveSpeed base route; express constraints inline.
Quote literal text and specify its position when rendering text.

workflows.label: Cartoon Scene
workflows.description: Generate a soft illustrated scene from a structured subject/action/style prompt.

groups.label: FLUX.2
prompt_rules: No negative prompt field; rewrite constraints positively.
Use BFL-style subject/action/style/context prompts.
flux-2-pro serves a text prompt only; reference images are not offered on this route.
LoRA base-model locks apply only to flux-2-dev; flux-2-pro does not accept LoRA weights.

workflows.label: Product Photo
workflows.description: Photoreal product/lifestyle still with positive-only constraints; text prompt only on the served flux-2-pro route.

groups.label: Recraft
prompt_rules: WaveSpeed Recraft V4 currently accepts prompt plus size only.
Put style and color direction into prompt text; do not send separate style/color params.
Raster layout workflows are for structured design assets, not photoreal images.

workflows.label: Logo / Icon / Safe Render
workflows.description: Generate raster logo, icon, and layout assets on the served Recraft V4 route, or use Imagen as the safe fallback route. The Recraft vector (SVG) route is listed but unavailable: no served route produces SVG.

groups.label: Article Illustrations
prompt_rules: Build shot list first; one image explains one core idea.
Pure white background, minimal black hand-drawn line art.
Sparse red, orange, or blue handwritten Chinese annotations.
Use Image Studio preflight or Codex imagegen; no provider call until approval.

workflows.label: Article Shot List
workflows.description: Turn article text or a concept into a shot list and first Image Studio prompt packet.
